itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur & City Palace Exploration
itinerary.description: Welcome to Jaipur! Meet our representative at the airport/railway station and check into your heritage stay. In the afternoon, visit the iconic City Palace, Jantar Mantar observatory, and click photos at the world-famous Hawa Mahal facade. Relax in the evening at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Amer Fort, Jaigarh & Nahargarh Sunset
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Amer Fort perched on the Aravalli hills with its stunning Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace). Explore Jaigarh Fort housing the world's largest cannon on wheels. Catch a magical sunset overlooking the entire pink city from Nahargarh Fort.

itinerary.title: Drive to Jodhpur – The Sun & Blue City
itinerary.description: Enjoy a scenic drive to Jodhpur (approx 5.5 hours). Check into your stay and stroll through the iconic blue painted alleyways of Navchokiya. Witness the clock tower and vibrant Sardar Market in the evening.

itinerary.title: Mehrangarh Fort & Jaswant Thada
itinerary.description: Visit one of India's largest and most magnificent forts — Mehrangarh Fort. Admire the marble cenotaph at Jaswant Thada, and discover the grand art-deco architecture of Umaid Bhawan Palace.

itinerary.title: Bishnoi Village Safari & Desert Sunset
itinerary.description: Embark on an authentic rural safari to meet local Bishnoi artisans, potters, and weavers. Experience genuine hospitality, spotting blackbucks in the wild, followed by a royal dinner with folk music.

itinerary.title: Departure from Jodhpur with Royal Memories
itinerary.description: Relish a hearty breakfast, pack your souvenirs, and check out. Our driver will drop you at Jodhpur Airport or Railway Station for your return journey.

If you're feeling adventurous, head out to explore nearby beaches like Candolim or Calangute on your own. Whether it's a sunset stroll, sipping coconut water, or simply lounging by the waves, this day is all about easing into vacation mode. Enjoy a peaceful overnight stay at your hotel. Welcome to the tropical paradise of Goa! 2 DAY 2 North Goa Sightseeing | Forts, Beaches & Adventure Start your day with a hearty breakfast before diving into the vibrant energy of North Goa. Afternoon visit Rajamala (eravikulam National Park - open as per the directions by the forest authorities ), the Best Place to see NilgiriTahr (Hermitragus Hilarious)- the Mountain goat of South India. itinerary.description: HA NOI ARRIVAL - TRANSFER TO SAPA BY SLEEPER BUS Welcome to Hanoi! - the capital of Vietnam, is a bustling metropolis with a rich history and culture. We will pick you up at Noi Bai Airport and transfer you to Sapa by sleeper bus Overnight in Sapa Welcome to Hanoi! We will pick you up at Noi Bai Airport and transfer you to Sapa by sleeper bus Overnight in Sapa 2 DAY 2 : PRIVATE FANSIPAN - MOANA Today, we'll drive to Sun Plaza Sapa Station. Upon arrival at the Fansipan Legend Cable Car Station, we take the cable car ride. This system has been recognized with 02 world records– the longest three-line cable car system in the world (6292.5 meters) in 2016, and it offers stunning views of the surrounding mountains. We'll ride up to an altitude of 2,800 meters. Upon reaching an altitude of 2,800 meters, you have a good time to view Sapa and take photos. After that, you also have a chance to visit a pagoda and trek up to 600 steps to reach the peak of Fansipan – the Roof of Indochina. Then come back to the Cable Car Station and return to Sapa town. Include 2 ways Fansipan funicular Visit to Moana site with artificial works arranged in harmony with nature. All create a unique, strange and beautiful landscape. The check-in area is 500m from the stone church, with more than 10,000m2 of area and view covering the majestic Hoang Lien range and Fansipan peak. This place consists of seven categories, attracting young people by many unique miniatures. These are the Bali heaven gate, Moana girl statue, infinity lake, golden hand, death swing, lonely tree, and coffee area. Back to Sapa and rest. 2 DAY 2 : PRIVATE FANSIPAN - MOANA Today, we'll drive to Sun Plaza Sapa Station. 2 2 DAY 2 : PRIVATE FANSIPAN - MOANA Today, we'll drive to Sun Plaza Sapa Station.

itinerary.title: PRIVATE FLY TO DA NANG - FREE DAY Welcome to
itinerary.description: PRIVATE FLY TO DA NANG - FREE DAY Welcome to Danang! Da Nang is a vibrant coastal city in central Vietnam that is home to stunning beaches, modern bridges, and historical landmarks. Upon Arrival, you are welcomed by our driver and transferred to the hotel to leave your heavy luggage. Free for leisure , Overnight in Da Nang Welcome to Danang! Free for leisure , Overnight in Da Nang 6 DAY 6 : SIC MARBLE MOUNTAIN - COCOCNUT VILLAGE - HOIAN ANCIENT TOWN In the afternoon, we transferred to visit Marble Mountain - a popular sightseeing location about 9km south of Da Nang City. It is a group of 5 hills, made of limestone and marble representing 5 elements: Water, Wood, Fire, Metal, and Earth. You can explore stunning caves, caverns, and pagodas and enjoy the beautiful panoramic view from the top of the mountain. Next, we transfer to visit Cam Thanh village and Bay Mau coconut forest. Here you have a chance to experience the traditional way of life. Take a bamboo basket boat tour through the coconut groves, learn how to paddle a traditional boat. Relax in the peaceful countryside by simply sitting back and enjoying the views. Learn about traditional handicrafts by watching local artisans weave baskets and mats using coconut leaves and other natural materials. After our transfer to Hoi An Ancient Town, we will be immersed in a magical world of Oriental feel. We will walk over the Japanese Bridge, visit Chinese Assembly halls, and explore ancient houses. We can also listen to folk music at old clubhouses or stroll into the market by the Thu Bon River. Here, we may feel the same inspiration as artists who have found the rooftops of Hoi An to be a source of inspiration. The rest of the time is free for shopping. Hoi An is legendary for its affordable yet quality tailoring services. The streets of the ancient town are also lined with shophouses and makeshift stalls selling handicrafts, jewelry, traditional apparel, and shoes. The central marketplace is filled with locals bargaining for fresh produce and foodstuffs. Hoi An town in the evening is a magical place, which is bathed in warm yellow light from the lanterns that hang from the shophouses, and the streets are filled with the sound of music and laughter. Overnight in Da Nang 6 DAY 6 : SIC MARBLE MOUNTAIN - COCOCNUT VILLAGE - HOIAN ANCIENT TOWN In the afternoon, we transferred to visit Marble Mountain - a popular sightseeing location about 9km south of Da Nang City. IT IS WELL-KNOWN PRACTICALLY ALL OVER THE WORLD. IT IS LOCATED 30 KM FROM THE CENTER OF BAKU IN THE SUBURB OF SURAKHANY. THIS TERRITORY IS KNOWN FOR SUCH UNIQUE NATURAL PHENOMENON AS BURNING NATURAL GAS OUTLETS (UNDERGROUND GAS COMING ONTO SURFACE CONTACTS OXYGEN AND LIGHTS UP). THE TEMPLE IN ITS PRESENT STATE WAS CONSTRUCTED IN THE 17TH-18TH CENTURIES AND BUILT BY THE BAKU-BASED HINDU COMMUNITY RELATED TO SIKHS. • BURNING MOUNTAIN- YANAR DAG OR THE FIRE MOUNTAIN IS ONE OF THE MAGICALLY ATTRACTIVE SITES, WHICH SURPRISES AND ENCHANTS VISITORS. IT SEEMS LIKE A BRILLIANT SPARKLING ON THE MOUNTAIN SURFACE. PEOPLE HAVE ALWAYS REGARDED THE MAGNIFICENT VIEW OF YANAR DAG AS SOMETHING "SACRED". • START BAKU CITY TOUR. • HEYDAR ALIYEV CENTER- CONSTRUCTION OF THE CENTER’S FACILITY WAS LAUNCHED IN 2007 AND COMPLETED ON MAY 10, 2012, TO CELEBRATE THE NATIONAL LEADER’S 89TH ANNIVERSARY. RECOGNIZED AS ONE OF THE WORLD’S MASTERPIECES IN ARCHITECTURE, THE HEYDAR ALIYEV CENTER HAS IMMEDIATELY GROWN INTO A SIGNATURE ARCHITECTURAL LANDMARK OF MODERN BAKU. ZAHA HADID, THE AUTHOR OF THE BUILDING'S DESIGN, IS A WORLDWIDE RECOGNIZED ARCHITECT AND THE WINNER OF THE PRESTIGIOUS PRITZKER ARCHITECTURE PRIZE.(OUTSIDE PHOTOSHOOTING) • VISIT TO NIZAMI STREET, FOUNTAIN SQUARE -CENTRAL STREET OF BAKU WHICH IS FULL OF SHOPS, RESTAURANTS • VISIT TO OLD CITY OF BAKU AND HAVING A TRIP AROUND THE CITY WALLS, DISCOVER RARE MONUMENTS WHICH LIST TO UNESCO WORLD HERITAGE LIST-MAIDEN TOWER, KARAVANSARAYS. THE HISTORICAL CORE OF BAKU, THE CAPITAL OF AZERBAIJAN. THE OLD CITY IS THE MOST ANCIENT PART OF BAKU, WHICH IS SURROUNDED BY WALLS WHICH WERE EASILY DEFENDED. IN 2007, THE OLD CITY HAD A POPULATION OF ABOUT 3000 PEOPLE. IN DECEMBER 2000, THE OLD CITY OF BAKU, INCLUDING THE PALACE OF THE SHIRVANSHAHS AND MAIDEN TOWER, BECAME THE FIRST LOCATION IN AZERBAIJAN TO BE CLASSIFIED AS A UNESCO WORLD HERITAGE SITE. • BAKU BOULEVARD- ESTABLISHED IN 1909 RUNS PARALLEL TO BAKU'S SEAFRONT. ITS HISTORY GOES BACK MORE THAN 100 YEARS, TO A TIME WHEN BAKU OIL BARONS BUILT THEIR MANSIONS ALONG THE CASPIAN SHORE AND WHEN THE SEAFRONT WAS ARTIFICIALLY BUILT UP INCH BY INCH. • LITTLE VENICE IN BAKU IS THE GREAT & CLEAN REFRESHING PARK TO WALK AND RELAX WITH KIDS OR THE FAMILY. VERY BEAUTIFUL & ASTONISHING SURROUNDINGS. FEELS LIKE YOU ARE AWAY FROM CITY YET IN THE CITY. UNIQUE & LOVELY RELAXING ATMOSPHERE. YOU CAN TAKE A RIDE IN GANDOLAS (VENETIAN BOATS), TAKE THE PICTURES, AND JUST ENJOY THE TRIP.(ENTRY TICKET IS NOT INCLUDE) • VISIT TO UPLAND PARK FOR PANORAMIC VIEW TO THE CITY-THE HIGHLAND PARK BAKU IS THE HIGHEST POINT OF THE CAPITAL OF AZERBAIJAN, FROM WHERE A BEAUTIFUL PANORAMA OF THE CITY AND THE BAY OPENS. PEOPLE FROM BAKU AND TOURISTS OFTEN COME HERE TO SEE BAKU FROM A BIRD’S EYE VIEW, AS WELL AS JUST TAKE A WALK. • FINISH THE TRIP AND BACK TO HOTEL 2 DAY 2 ABSHERON+BAKU CITY TOUR BREAKFAST AT HOTEL • START ABSHERON TOUR • ATESHGAH TEMPLE- IS AN AUTHENTIC AZERBAIJANI EXOTIC. • FINISH THE TRIP AND BACK TO HOTEL 2 2 DAY 2 ABSHERON+BAKU CITY TOUR BREAKFAST AT HOTEL • START ABSHERON TOUR • ATESHGAH TEMPLE- IS AN AUTHENTIC AZERBAIJANI EXOTIC. • FINISH THE TRIP AND BACK TO HOTEL

itinerary.description: Arrive into London, the capital of England and the United Kingdom. Greetings! Today marks the commencement of our journey as we embark on a flight to a captivating city renowned for its vibrant culture, cosmopolitan atmosphere, and intriguing history – London, the capital of England. Upon arrival, you will be warmly welcomed by our amiable and knowledgeable Tour Manager, and later proceed to the hotel and check in. Take some time to unwind and enjoy the comforts of your accommodation. 2 Day 2 Guided city tour of London with Changing of Guards. Visit to the famous Madame Tussauds Wax Museum. Visit the legendary Lord’s Cricket Ground. Ride the London Eye. Post breakfast, we drive to explore the city of London with our expert local guide. You will see important landmarks like the Big Ben, Houses of Parliament, Westminster Abbey, Trafalgar Square, Piccadilly Circus, Tower Bridge, River Thames, Hyde Park and many more. Witness the Changing of the Guards at Buckingham Palace (subject to operation). Next, we proceed to visit the renowned Madame Tussauds wax museum. Be enthralled by the world’s largest wax collection of famous personalities. Later, visit one of the iconic cricketing venues in London – the Lord’s Cricket Ground. In Lord’s you will have an opportunity to go behind the scenes at the ‘Home of Cricket’, and to experience some of the most inspiring views in sport. See the iconic parts of the ground including the Grade II*-listed Victorian Pavilion, the world-famous Long Room, the Players’ Dressing Rooms, and the MCC Museum, home of the Ashes Urn – cricket’s best-known artefact. Later we visit London eye, one of the many iconic highlights of the city. Enjoy scenic views of the city while you ride the London eye. It is one of the most popular tourist attractions in the United Kingdom, standing at 135 meters tall overlooking the river Thames and the beautiful city of London. Overnight stay at the hotel in London. (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner) 2 Day 2 Guided city tour of London with Changing of Guards. (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner) 2 2 Day 2 Guided city tour of London with Changing of Guards. (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur + Heritage Trail Welcome to
itinerary.description: Arrival in Jaipur + Heritage Trail Welcome to the royal city of Jaipur! Upon arrival, check into your hotel and take some time to freshen up. itinerary.title: Arrival in Jodhpur – Exploring the Blue City
itinerary.description: Arrival in Jodhpur – Exploring the Blue City Arrive in Jodhpur, the gateway to Marwar, and check into your hotel. Begin your exploration with the awe-inspiring Mehrangarh Fort, towering over the city and offering panoramic views of the iconic blue houses below. Wander through its courtyards and museum, rich with artifacts and tales of valor. Next, visit the peaceful Jaswant Thada, a marble cenotaph surrounded by gardens. In the afternoon, marvel at the grandeur of Umaid Bhawan Palace, part royal residence and part museum. End your day at Sardar Market, where the colors of Rajasthan come alive in textiles, spices, and handicrafts. Enjoy dinner at a rooftop restaurant with the fort glowing in the distance. Arrive in Jodhpur, the gateway to Marwar, and check into your hotel. 2 DAY 2 Drive to Jaisalmer – Desert Camp Experience After a hearty breakfast, begin your scenic drive to Jaisalmer, passing through rustic villages and arid landscapes that paint a picture of rural Rajasthan. En route, stop at the mysterious Kuldhara Village, an abandoned settlement with eerie legends and crumbling architecture. Upon reaching Sam Sand Dunes, check into your desert camp and unwind with welcome drinks. As the sun begins to set, embark on a camel safari across the golden dunes, soaking in the surreal beauty of the desert. The evening unfolds with a cultural program featuring traditional Rajasthani music and dance, followed by a delicious dinner under the stars. Spend the night in a cozy Swiss tent, surrounded by the tranquil desert. 2 2 DAY 2 Drive to Jaisalmer – Desert Camp Experience After a hearty breakfast, begin your scenic drive to Jaisalmer, passing through rustic villages and arid landscapes that paint a picture of rural Rajasthan.

Later in the evening, evening visit to Swayambhunath Stupa (Monkey Temple) – a hilltop Buddhist shrine offering panoramic views and spiritual ambiance. Then, visit to “Boudhnath Stupa”, the stupa gave birth to the origins of Tibetan Buddhism. Visit International Mountain Museum (if you are a mountaineering enthusiast). After breakfast, visit the Davis Fall (locally known as पाताले छााँगो. It is a ferocious waterfall located about 2 km southwest of Pokhara Airport on the Siddhartha Highway. The source of the waterfall is Phewa Lake and the fall itself is named after Swiss lady who was swept away by the fall in 1961. The fall cuts through the rocks to create complex caves and tunnels on its path. Gupteshwar Mahadev cave on the other side of the fall is one such cave carved by Devi’s Fall. The sacred shrine dedicated to Shiva is popular among the local residents and is seldom missed by tourists to Davi’s Fall. In evening, visit Tal Barahi temple (Nepali: तालबाराही मन्दिर) also known as ‘Lake Temple’ or ‘Barahi Temple’ is a Hindu temple of the goddess Barahi. It is the most important religious monument in Pokhara, Nepal. This temple is located on a small island in the middle of Phewa Lake. As the temple is situated on a small island, the only way to visit it is by boat. Overnight stay at hotel Early morning visit to Sarangkot for sunrise or paragliding (at your own cost) over Fewa lake. Overnight stay at hotel 5 DAY 5 POKHARA EXPLORATION After breakfast, visit to “Shree Bindhyabasini Temple”, the main temple is devoted to the goddess Bindhyabasini, a Bhagawati (भगवती) who is the incarnation of Kali. It is the oldest temple in Pokhara. Later, visit to Shanti Stupa, standing on top of the Anadu Hill, Shanti Stupa adds beauty to the Pokhara Valley. It is a perfect holiday place providing a clear view of the Himalayan range, Fewa Lake and Pokhara city. The hilltop provides a splendid view of sunrise and sunset. Late, visit Seti River Gorge, famous for its deceptive river course and its milky white water. The water cuts a deep gorge right across the mighty Mahabharata range and then runs a deep chasm in the middle of the town. The gorge can be seen from a park in the Old pokhara close to the Gorkha Museum. Overnight stay at hotel. 5 DAY 5 POKHARA EXPLORATION After breakfast, visit to “Shree Bindhyabasini Temple”, the main temple is devoted to the goddess Bindhyabasini, a Bhagawati (भगवती) who is the incarnation of Kali. 5 5 DAY 5 POKHARA EXPLORATION After breakfast, visit to “Shree Bindhyabasini Temple”, the main temple is devoted to the goddess Bindhyabasini, a Bhagawati (भगवती) who is the incarnation of Kali.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Guwahati – Transfer to Kaziranga N
itinerary.description: Arrival in Guwahati – Transfer to Kaziranga National Park Upon arrival at Guwahati Airport or Railway Station, you’ll be greeted by our representative and begin your scenic journey to Kaziranga National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and home to the famed one-horned rhinoceros. The drive takes approximately 4.5 hours and winds through lush tea gardens, tribal villages, and the Brahmaputra plains. Once you reach Kaziranga, check into your jungle lodge or resort nestled in the wilderness. Spend the evening exploring the nearby Orchid & Biodiversity Park, which showcases over 500 species of orchids and medicinal plants. You can also visit the Kaziranga National Orchid and Biodiversity Museum or enjoy a quiet walk through the tea gardens. The tranquil surroundings and chirping of birds set the tone for the adventure ahead. Enjoy a traditional Assamese dinner at your lodge and rest well for the early morning safari. Dinner & Overnight in Kaziranga Upon arrival at Guwahati Airport or Railway Station, you’ll be greeted by our representative and begin your scenic journey to Kaziranga National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and home to the famed one-horned rhinoceros. Dinner & Overnight in Kaziranga 2 DAY 2 Elephant Safari & Jeep Safari Rise early for an unforgettable Elephant Safari in the Eastern Range of Kaziranga. The safari begins around 6:00 AM and offers a close-up view of rhinos, swamp deer, wild buffaloes, and migratory birds in their natural habitat. Riding atop an elephant through misty grasslands is a surreal experience that brings you face-to-face with the park’s wildlife. After breakfast, relax at the lodge or visit a nearby tea estate. In the afternoon, embark on a Jeep Safari in the Central or Western Range, which covers deeper forested areas and wetlands. This zone is known for tiger sightings, herds of elephants, and rich birdlife. The safaris are guided by forest experts who share insights into the park’s ecology and conservation efforts. In the evening, you may attend a cultural performance featuring Bihu or Jhoomar dance, showcasing Assam’s vibrant traditions. The day ends with a hearty dinner and stories around the bonfire. Visit the Indo-Bangladesh border viewpoint and interact with locals. Continue to Mawlynnong, awarded the title of Asia’s cleanest village. Walk through its spotless lanes, bamboo dustbins, and flower-laden gardens. Enjoy a short trek to the Living Root Bridge, a natural marvel created by weaving roots of rubber trees over decades. Mawlynnong also offers views of the plains of Bangladesh from its skywalk. The day combines nature, culture, and sustainability in a unique way. Return to Shillong by evening and enjoy your final dinner in the hills. Head straight to the revered Kamakhya Temple, one of India’s most powerful Shakti Peethas. Located atop Nilachal Hill, the temple is dedicated to Goddess Kamakhya and symbolizes feminine energy and fertility. The temple’s architecture resembles a beehive and features intricate carvings and sculptures. Participate in the morning darshan and witness the unique rituals performed by the temple priests. The spiritual ambiance and panoramic views of the Brahmaputra River make this a fitting end to your journey. After darshan, you’ll be dropped at Guwahati Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey, carrying with you the blessings of the goddess and unforgettable memories of Assam and Meghalaya.
